sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Defines the structure, roles, and processes for managing security across the organization. Aligns with business strategy and operational needs. Includes governance, service delivery, and performance metrics. Serves as a blueprint for security operations, transformation and innovation.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Enables scalable and consistent security operations. Clarifies roles and responsibilities across teams. Improves efficiency and accountability. Supports strategic alignment and transformation goals. Enhances resilience and adaptability to threats.

sections.heading: Related Guidelines & Tools
items: Standard approach available, to be tailored to client needs
